title: Designer Preflight findings
description: Designer Preflight findings. Shared by the preflight CLI, the designer-preflight skill, and FlowMap. Lives at .preflight/findings.json in the checked project.

key.description: Stable fingerprint so a status survives re-scans

severity.description: P0 blocks launch, P1 fix before wide release, P2 polish

screen.description: Route the finding shows up on, when known

screens.description: Every route the finding shows up on, when it affects more than one

what.description: What is wrong, in one sentence

why.description: Why it matters, in plain language

evidence.description: Short excerpt or tool output, secrets redacted

note.description: Why a risk was accepted, or what the fix commit was

source.description: Credits for the rule or data, see CREDITS.md
